our_interpretation: The plain reading concerns visual quality, rather than intelligence, originality, or prompt accuracy.
The surrounding discussion concerns the generation of systems available since DALL-E 2 appeared in 2022, through the post date. April through September 18 is the assessment window.
A fair comparison would use comparable image-making tasks and distinguish ordinary participants from highly trained artists. Neither training level nor a quality threshold is specified.
criteria.support_condition: Blinded comparisons of contemporaneous model outputs and human work show high model image quality, with superior human performance confined to highly trained artists.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable blinded evaluations show that people without extensive artistic training reliably surpass the contemporaneous systems in visual quality.
